checks.title: Removed variables set in an option file or on the command line
checks.description: The target does not have these variables. An unknown option in an option file or on the command line stops mysqld from starting (unless written with the loose- prefix): remove them first.

checks.title: Removed variables persisted with SET PERSIST
checks.description: The target logs a warning and ignores them at startup; RESET PERSIST removes them.

checks.title: Names that are reserved words in the target
checks.description: Reserved in the target (checked: QUALIFY, TABLESAMPLE). Statements must quote these names with backticks; names in routine, view and trigger bodies are not parsed here.

checks.title: utf8 / utf8mb3 columns
checks.description: utf8mb3 is deprecated and still supported in the target; plan a conversion to utf8mb4.

checks.title: Zero date defaults
checks.description: CREATE TABLE or ALTER TABLE with these defaults fails under the default sql_mode (strict, with NO_ZERO_DATE and NO_ZERO_IN_DATE). Stored row data is not scanned.

checks.title: mysql_native_password accounts
checks.description: MySQL 8.4 disables mysql_native_password by default (mysql_native_password=ON enables it) and 9.0 removes it. Needs SELECT on mysql.user.

checks.title: Old binary temporal formats
checks.description: Not reliably detectable from cheap column metadata. Use the full Shell checker; no CHECK TABLE or table scan was run.

limitations: Subset; install MySQL Shell for the full check. This does not establish that an upgrade is safe.

Not checked: option file contents (only where MySQL 8.0+ says a removed variable came from), routine, view and trigger bodies, row data, old temporal storage, foreign keys, removed functions, and variables or keywords outside the short lists in myflames/lifecycle.py.
